job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Arizona Public Safety Personnel Retirement System RFP for non-discretionary investment consultant services, not the TMRS global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria and weights are different, so they do not support the requested TMRS criteria.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is issued by the Board of Trustees (“Board”) of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (“System”), acting in their capacity as administrators of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System Trust, for the purpose of hiring a non-discretionary investment consultant to provide non-discretionary investment consultant services.
 30 percent - Quality and extent of the firm’s capabilities regarding:
 20 percent - Overall cost of firm’s proposed services.
